description: Fresh prompts for the pre-registered confirmations of the specific switch (Gemma 2 v5, Gemma 3), written 2026-10-03 by an annotator who saw no results: six everyday genres x 20 plus 20 explicit requests for the pattern. Avoids every earlier prompt set.
